name: Kahn
summary: The company clerk, at right in the guitar photographs VN-0003 and VN-0008, with Ron Tototz beside him. Larry remembers that he "walked funny, stiff legged like he had polio." On 2026-09-12 he said: "Right is Kahn, he was the company clerk, morning report written by him," and of VN-0007, where Kahn is not in the picture, "Kahn must be taking the picture."
researchNotes: "Company secretary" was Larry's word on 2026-08-13 (giscus-vn-0003-c18006986); "company clerk" on 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0003-c18415619). The two are the same job, and the role uses the later word. The spelling is his son's rendering of the sound; Kahn, Khan, Conn and Kohn are all candidates. 2026-08-23 (giscus-stories-c18118728, his son's paraphrase): "Khan wrote the morning reports for the Unit." Repeated unprompted three weeks later, which strengthens it as memory, though not as fact. If the unit's morning reports are obtained (issue #27), his name should appear on them as the clerk who typed them, which would corroborate this account. "Kahn must be taking the picture" is Larry reasoning from who is missing, not a memory of Kahn holding the camera.
